name: Staged, rugless: the MORABO sofa with chaise and two POÄNG chairs around the UGGLERUM, a wall lamp by the window, two cork mats on the play floor
notes:
Later on 2026-10-26 Andrew's cart added the IKEA PS LÖMSK children's swivel armchair with its shark slipcover: it takes the window corner of the play wall in place of the SMÅSTAD reading bench (a storage piece, Saturday's decision), x 236.625-261, y 18-41.25, 18" from the heater's drawn face (F-33), under the UPPLYST cloud lamp and the VARPTROSS reading light, 14" above the TROFAST; the route along the window ends at it. Recommended for 3 and older (F-21).
Staged since the evening of 2026-10-26, when Andrew settled it ("we are going with rugless for allergy conerns, wife wins."): the rug-free room (F-66), kept piece for piece from e, the room with its rugs, which stays as the alternative.
Rug-free alternative (F-66): the staged room (a; the MORABO Sofa with chaise since Andrew's cart of 2026-10-26, the UGGLERUM and the two POÄNG chairs with their ottomans since that evening) piece for piece without the TIOKRONA and the LEN, for a family that may skip rugs for dust and dust mites. No TV (F-65); the open side's walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42).
The sofa (F-67, Andrew 2026-10-25: "a chaise, i.e. at least 3 seats", "empty space between like" the MORABO chaise add-on, "the largest sofa / sectional / chaise that can fit"): MORABO in Gunnared dark gray on 6 1/4" wood legs, the open base he linked, high enough for a robot vacuum. Its cover is fixed (vacuum and wipe, not washable); the same pieces in Grann/Bomstad leather wipe clean and hold no dust mites (F-66). The sofa is delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22): Andrew can't tape the stairs before the move (2026-10-26, F-07). It is in his cart to order on 2026-10-26, his call: its boxes are the loveseat frame's, 69 x 37 x 21" at 115 lb 12 oz, and the chaise section's, 64 1/2 x 32 1/4 x 21 1/2" at 69 lb 4 oz, each smaller than the U's corner frame (78 1/2 x 36 3/4 x 20 1/4"); the cart page says returns within 365 days.
What replaced each rug: the TIOKRONA under the conversation group gives way to the sofa itself, which holds the UGGLERUM between its chaise and its seats, and the two POÄNG chairs beside it; the LEN play rug gives way to two cork mats on natural rubber side by side (play-mat-1 and play-mat-2, 52 x 80" together, x 188-240, y 52-132), wipeable and plastic-free (Andrew, 2026-10-25: "something that isn't literally plastic"), in place of the GREJSIMOJS, whose cover is polyester with a polyurethane coat. No plastic-free mat came bigger: the 72 x 48" cork mats have plastic (TPE) backs. The rubber backs grip the floor, so the pair stays put; the LÄTT stands on the left mat (it straddled the seam until the final audit 2026-10-26).
F-66 moves: (1) the sofa around one anchor, the UGGLERUM, 16" from its seats and 14" from the chaise, the two POÄNG chairs and their ottomans beside it; (2) light marking each zone: a VARPTROSS on the window wall for the group (the TÅGARP came off at the final audit 2026-10-26: its cord would have crossed the heater), the UPPLYST and a second VARPTROSS over the reading bench and the VARPTROSS over the BESTÅ for the play corner; (3) wall anchors on the play wall, the PJÄTTERYD over the TROFAST and the RÖDALM over the BESTÅ (the sofa faces the window, which stays the focal point); (4) the palette off the floor in machine-washable cushion covers, the throw and the curtains; (5) the FEJKA at the arm's end; (6) the cork mats on the play floor.
sofa-1, coffee-table-1, armchair-1, ottoman-1, armchair-2, ottoman-2, wall-lamp-3, plant-1: as in e (F-33, F-39, F-40, F-42 the same; delivery-path-unmeasured for the sofa, F-22; corner guards on the UGGLERUM, F-21). As in e, the first POÄNG ends 11.9" short of the LÄTT, a dead gap, the second keeps the window route at 30", and the way to the play wall runs east of the LÄTT.
Play area (F-61): the SMÅSTAD reading bench with the UPPLYST, the TROFAST with 24" clear in front (F-32, the mats run under that clear floor), the BESTÅ toy cabinet with the FLISAT and the VARPTROSS, the PJÄTTERYD and the RÖDALM, and the LÄTT on the left cork mat (x 188.6-213.4, y 98-116.9), 11.9" past the first POÄNG and 30.7" on the diagonal from its corner to the TROFAST's corner, the way from the kitchen side to the play wall (F-30; at x 200-224.75 both ways past it were under 30" until the final audit 2026-10-26), 26.1" above the walkway's edge, room for its lower chair (F-42).
Natural rubber: it smells for a while at first, keep it out of direct sun, and it is latex (nobody in the family is allergic: Andrew, 2026-10-26).
Not placed: the TIOKRONA, the LEN and the GREJSIMOJS (F-66); the rest as in e.
Stairs: beyond the left wall behind a railing (F-40), so the 36" strip along it (x 0-36) stays clear its whole length, landings included; the bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the floor along the window (F-30). Which end people step off is unknown.
Heater: clearances run from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces from y 12, upholstery from y 18 (F-33). It runs the whole window wall, so the GINSTMOTT panels must stay off it: hem them to end above it once its height is known, or hang blinds as the office does. Window: eyeballed on the top wall (assumed-position:window); nothing stands under it (F-38).
Power: outlets can only be on the window wall and the play wall, and where they are isn't recorded; the heater runs the whole window wall, so a cord to an outlet there must come down the wall in a cover from a wall lamp, never across the heater from a floor lamp (final audit 2026-10-26), and the UPPLYST and VARPTROSS cords on the play wall run down it in covers.
Kid safety (F-21): no glass; the FLISAT book display stands on the 15" BESTÅ, 31" together, so fix it to the wall; nothing else is over 27".
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1, SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x2, FJÄDRAR inserts x4, VALLKRASSING throw x1. No LÖVA canopy: it gathers dust and washes only by hand.
Total $3,019.79: placed $2,786.86 + extras $232.93; prices as of 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-26 (those before today price-stale, F-02). Flags across the layout: delivery-path-unmeasured, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
Final audit 2026-10-26: the LÄTT moved 11.4" west, so the way from the kitchen side to the play wall is 30.7" (both ways past it were under 30": 22.25" beside the U's arm and 19.5" to the TROFAST's corner), onto the left cork mat; the TÅGARP became a VARPTROSS on the window wall, since its cord would have crossed the heater to reach any outlet there (F-33); a second VARPTROSS over the reading bench is the play wall's reading light.
